definitions.explanation: A business owned and operated by a single individual without forming a corporation. In Japan, this is a specific legal and tax category distinct from a company ({法人|ほうじん}).

examples.japanese: {個人事業|こじんじぎょう}を{始|はじ}めた。
{個人事業|こじんじぎょう}の{届出|とどけで}を{税務署|ぜいむしょ}に{出|だ}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to file a sole proprietorship registration with the tax office.

examples.japanese: フリーランスとして{働|はたら}く{場合|ばあい}、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{個人事業|こじんじぎょう}{主|ぬし}として{確定申告|かくていしんこく}をする。
examples.english: When working as a freelancer, many people file tax returns as a sole proprietor.

notes:
Composed of {個人|こじん} (individual) + {事業|じぎょう} (business). This is a formal legal and tax term in Japan. A person running a {個人事業|こじんじぎょう} is called a {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし} (sole proprietor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}: sole proprietor
- {個人事業|こじんじぎょう}の{開業届|かいぎょうとどけ}: business opening notification
- {個人事業|こじんじぎょう}を{始|はじ}める: to start a sole proprietorship
- {個人事業|こじんじぎょう}{税|ぜい}: individual business tax

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自営業|じえいぎょう}: self-employment — more general and everyday term for working for oneself
- {法人|ほうじん}: corporation — a legally incorporated entity, contrasted with {個人事業|こじんじぎょう}
- フリーランス: freelancer — describes the work style rather than the legal business structure
